name: @breeze/runtime
//gsap: GSAP is a devDependency on purpose: it is no longer bundled into anything Breeze ships. The runtime imports it as a bare specifier, and both bundlers alias that to src/vendor/gsap-global.ts, which reads window.gsap — loaded from /public/vendor/gsap/ as an unmodified UMD file an operator can replace without rebuilding. The package is still installed here for its TypeScript types, for the unit tests (which exercise the real library), and as the source scripts/vendor-gsap.mjs copies from. Pinned with ~ rather than ^: the loaded file and the compiled-against types are now two separate things, so the pin is what keeps them from drifting silently. Bumping it is a deliberate act.
